purpose: Teach: アキ/垂れ/行儀/ドーナツ/スナック/埃/味わえる/うんと

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達のアキちゃん、本気で、優しい子なんだよ、ぼく、絶対、好きなんだ、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Mom — Aki, my friend, is really kind. I really, really like her. I promise.
lines.style: Urgent, bubbling excitement. Repetition comes from genuine conviction, not agitation. Leaning forward. Eyes bright. The intensity of a six-year-old trying to make sure you understand something he deeply feels.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お味噌、ポタポタ、垂れちゃってるわよ、翔くん、絶対、気をつけてね、ふきんで、絶対、拭こうね。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. But your miso is dripping, Sho. Be careful, okay? Wipe it up with the cloth.
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Warm underneath, but present and attentive — she's noticed, and it matters. Not scolding. The tone of someone watching, always watching, and speaking up when it counts.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、食事の行儀、絶対、よくするからね、ママ、約束、本気で、絶対、本当に、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: I'll be really careful with my manners, Mom. I promise. I really promise.
lines.style: Solemn reassurance. He's making a contract with her. Steady voice, no hesitation. The small seriousness of a child who wants to keep his word and knows she's listening.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おやつに、本気で、絶対、ドーナツ、買ってきたわよ、翔くん、本気で、楽しみよね
lines.en: I bought donuts for snack time, Sho. You're going to have fun with those.
lines.style: Warm delivery, almost conspiratorial — she's offering him something she knows will delight him. A small moment of generosity. Not making a big show of it, just stating a gift as fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達と、本気で、絶対、スナック、シェアしながら、絶対、楽しい時間、過ごしてるよ、ママ、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: I'm going to share the snacks with my friend, and we're going to have such a good time together, Mom. Really.
lines.style: Animated joy. The words tumble out — he's picturing it already. Not hyperactive, but alive. A child painting the future he can already see, wanting to make sure she sees it too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お部屋、本気で、絶対、埃、絶対、たまっているわよ、翔くん、お母さんと、絶対、お掃除、しましょうね、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: But your room is dusty, Sho. Come on — let's clean it up together, okay?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical. She's not asking; she's inviting him into the work. The tone shifts slightly — this is what comes next. Present, steady, the rhythm of a mother and son moving through the day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんの料理、本気で、絶対、深い味、絶対、味わえるんだよ、ママ、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Grandma's cooking — it has such deep flavor, Mom. I'm really grateful for it.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. He's discovering something true about taste and care. Slow, thoughtful. The voice of a child noticing that food is love, and meaning it. A moment of unexpected clarity from someone small.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏休み、本気で、絶対、うんと、楽しい時間、絶対、過ごしましょうね、翔くん、約束、本気で、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Summer's going to be such a fun time for us, Sho. Let's make it really special together, okay? I promise.
lines.style: Tender closing. She's giving him the whole summer to look forward to, and she's in it with him. Warm, present, a mother's quiet vow. Slight softness on the trailing words — a gentle fadeout.
